content.short: Beyond Rockets is a creative studio and NFT project building voxel-style blockchain art worlds and collectibles.
content.description: Beyond Rockets is a creative studio and NFT project known for isometric, voxel-style blockchain art. Its collections include houses, rooms, buildings, characters, and city-like pieces that fit together like parts of a larger metropolis. The project connects digital art, storytelling, and collectible ownership, with releases that have extended beyond Cardano into early Bitcoin Ordinals activity. Beyond Rockets is best understood as an art-led studio that turns themed environments into collectible on-chain pieces.
